title: Mexico Requests Meeting with US to Regulate SpaceX Flights and Airspace Use
author: José Shaddai Olvera Torres
content:
_This article by[José Shaddai Olvera
Torres](https://elchamuco.com.mx/author/shaddai/) originally appeared in the
[November 26, 2026 edition of El Chamuco y los Hijos del
Averno](https://elchamuco.com.mx/2026/11/26/mexico-pide-reunion-con-eu-para-
regular-vuelos-de-spacex-y-el-uso-del-espacio-aereo/), a Mexican outlet
covering politics and investigative reporting._

**(NOVEMBER 26, 2026).-The Mexican government asked the US Embassy to arrange
a meeting between the two countries’ aerospace authorities to establish the
conditions under which SpaceX may use Mexican airspace during its launches
from Texas, President Claudia Sheinbaum reported.**

During her morning press conference this Thursday, November 26, the president
explained that the request responds to the company’s plans to increase the
frequency of its operations from the border area. According to projections
cited by Sheinbaum, SpaceX is considering **up to 400 flights a year**.

The president noted that, even when launches are operated by a private
company, using part of Mexican airspace **requires authorization from the
national authorities**. She therefore maintained that it is up to the
governments of Mexico and the United States to establish the permits, flight
frequency and conditions for carrying out the operations.

Sheinbaum also proposed that, if circumstances require it, consideration be
given to the possibility of relocating the company’s launch area. Its Starbase
facility is in Texas, near the Mexican border.

## Space Debris Under Investigation in Tamaulipas

The request for bilateral dialogue comes after fragments associated with a
launch of the Starship spacecraft reached Playa Bagdad, in Matamoros,
Tamaulipas.

The Federal Attorney’s Office for Environmental Protection (Profepa) reported
that it collected and secured approximately **5.9 kilograms of debris** in the
area. The materials have been secured while the relevant assessments are
carried out.

On this matter, Sheinbaum said Profepa must investigate the potential
environmental impacts and that, if necessary, the appropriate complaints will
be filed against the company.

The president distinguished between coordination with the US government to
regulate airspace use and SpaceX’s potential environmental liabilities, which
must be determined through investigations by the Mexican authorities.
